API Reference
*************

.. automodule:: bootstrap_stat

.. note::

   The ``alpha`` parameter in all interval functions controls the
   per-tail probability, so ``alpha=0.05`` produces a **90%** interval
   (5% excluded from each tail). This follows the convention in
   [ET93]_.
